maria: LexiData flagged a tax issue  they say VAT was applied twice on reseller credits across 5 invoices (May). They report total tax overcharge €4,560. Can finance triage? cc @kevin
kevin: Can you attach the invoices + tax_calculation export?
billing-bot: Files uploaded by @billing-sync: https://redwood.cloud/invoices/LEX-2026-MAY-bundle.zip, https://redwood.cloud/exports/tax_calc_lexidata_may.csv
maria: Attached CSV shows duplicate VAT lines: tax_rate 20% applied at both partner and sub-customer level. Looks like a shipping rule misflagged reverse-charge.
ashley: Accounting here  quick glance confirms duplicated tax lines on INV-LEX-501, INV-LEX-502, INV-LEX-503, INV-LEX-504, INV-LEX-505. Opening FIN-8105 to track.
tax-bot: Automated check: duplicated VAT detected on 5 invoices, suggested action: issue tax-only credit memos and create corrected invoices with reverse-charge annotation.
kevin: Policy: tax miscalculations require tax credits + corrected invoices, do not issue cash refunds for tax lines unless requested by local tax authority. Approvers: finance director signoff.
sara: Approved. Issue tax-only credit memos for the full €4,560 and generate corrected invoices with reverse-charge notation. Use GL 4070 (tax adjustments). Also notify tax@redwood for filing.
ashley: Running billing-cli to create memos and corrected invoices:
```
billing-cli create-tax-credit --invoice INV-LEX-501 --amount 912 --gl 4070 --note "duplicate VAT 20% - tax adjustment"
billing-cli create-tax-credit --invoice INV-LEX-502 --amount 912 --gl 4070 --note "duplicate VAT 20% - tax adjustment"
billing-cli create-tax-credit --invoice INV-LEX-503 --amount 912 --gl 4070 --note "duplicate VAT 20% - tax adjustment"
billing-cli create-tax-credit --invoice INV-LEX-504 --amount 912 --gl 4070 --note "duplicate VAT 20% - tax adjustment"
billing-cli create-tax-credit --invoice INV-LEX-505 --amount 912 --gl 4070 --note "duplicate VAT 20% - tax adjustment"
```
billing-bot: Tax credit memos created: TC-2026-501, TC-2026-502, TC-2026-503, TC-2026-504, TC-2026-505. Corrected invoices generated: CORR-LEX-501..CORR-LEX-505. Linked to FIN-8105 and tax@redwood.
maria: I'll notify LexiData with the TC IDs and corrected invoice links and explain no cash refund for tax was issued (credit memos applied to invoices). They asked for a goodwill for time spent.
kevin: Recommend one-time goodwill promo €200 to vendor for ops disruption. Approver: finance director.
sara: Approved €200 goodwill promo, GL 4005.
billing-bot: Promo created: GP-2026-056 applied to LexiData account.
nashley: FIN-8105: all billing actions done, awaiting vendor acknowledgement of corrected invoices. Will close once vendor confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
